stats.name: runnersLeftOnBase
stats.description: The number runners remain on base after the batter makes an out at the plate.

stats.name: triples
stats.description: The number of hits that result in the batter reaching 3rd base without the aid of an error.

stats.name: doubles
stats.description: The number of times that a batter reaches second base as the result of a hit without an error being committed.

stats.name: caughtStealing

stats.name: totalBases

stats.name: extraBaseHits

stats.name: slugAvg

articles.headline: Donald Trump considers executive order on NCAA athletes' employment status
articles.description: President Donald Trump is considering an executive order that would require federal authorities to clarify whether college athletes can be considered employees of their schools.

images.name: Todd Golden Donald Trump [1296x729]
images.caption: Florida men's basketball coach Todd Golden presents President Donald Trump with a uniform with his name on it as Trump hosted the Gators to celebrate their 2025 NCAA championship at the White House on Tuesday.

images.name: Big Ten, Big 12 to partner with PayPal to enable payments for student-athletes
images.caption: Big 12 commissioner Brett Yormark joins "Get Up" to announce that the Big Ten and Big 12 will partner with PayPal to distribute funds to student-athletes.

articles.headline: Louisiana Tech returns to Sun Belt Conference as 14th member
articles.description: The Sun Belt's CEOs voted to invite Louisiana Tech as the league's 14th member Monday morning.

images.name: Louisiana Tech Bulldogs vs. Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders: Game Highlights
images.caption: Louisiana Tech Bulldogs vs. Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders: Game Highlights

articles.headline: Which colleges have the most first-round MLB draft picks?
articles.description: Stanford comes in first for the most all-time first-round picks in the MLB draft. Check out which other teams make the list.

images.name: Malcolm Moore [608x342]
images.caption: Malcolm Moore was selected in the first round of the 2024 MLB draft, from Stanford to the Texas Rangers.

articles.headline: Nationals surprise at top of MLB draft with SS Eli Willits
articles.description: The Nationals took high school shortstop Eli Willits with the No. 1 pick in the MLB draft, while Tyler Bremner went No. 2 to the Angels and LSU's Kade Anderson to the Mariners at No. 3.

images.name: Ethan Holliday and Eli Willits [1296x729] - Copy
images.caption: Eli Willits, right, who attended Fort Cobb-Broxton (Oklahoma) High School, was taken No. 1 in the MLB draft by the Nationals, and Stillwater's Ethan Holliday, left, was selected fourth overall by Colorado.

articles.headline: Bill in Congress would bar using student fees for athletics
articles.description: A bill to regulate college sports introduced in the House on Thursday would offer limited antitrust protection for the NCAA, while barring schools from using student fees to pay for college athletic programs.

articles.headline: Kade Anderson's MLB draft profile
articles.description: Kiley McDaniel explains what makes LSU's Kade Anderson one of the top prospects in this year's MLB draft.

images.name: Kade Anderson's MLB draft profile
images.caption: Kiley McDaniel explains what makes LSU's Kade Anderson one of the top prospects in this year's MLB draft.
